verdict.rationale: Square documents APIs and an official TypeScript SDK for retrieving seller data, including locations, catalog, inventory and payouts, so a user could pull their data out programmatically with their own tooling. Nothing in the evidence describes a first-party bulk export, an open-format download such as CSV, or an account-exit or portability path. missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open export formats (CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all data types, offboarding/data-portability guidance, independent corroboration that complete export works
